Kamil is a Scala Engineer at VirtusLab, previously Senior DevOps Engineer, and then Domain Architect at ING Tech Poland. Currently, in his work, he deals with the creation of a global shipment tracking system based on microservices.

He started his professional career in IT during his studies, in 2016. So far I have had the opportunity to write production applications in C #, Java, Kotlin, Scala, and TypeScript that work with SQL and NoSQL databases.

Hobbies: electric guitar, music theory, canine behavior.
